candidate_relations.reason: The label states psammomatoid juvenile ossifying fibroma was considered and excluded, so it asserts an incompatible JOF subtype.
Fibrous dysplasia is the main related fibro-osseous differential but is a distinct entity from juvenile ossifying fibroma.
Odontogenic tumor is a broad jaw-tumor parent and does not specify juvenile ossifying fibroma.
Juvenile active ossifying fibroma is an accepted synonym of juvenile ossifying fibroma.
Aneurysmal bone cyst is a related cystic lesion that can accompany JOF, not the fibro-osseous diagnosis itself.
Trabecular juvenile ossifying fibroma is a recognized JOF subtype and is compatible with exclusion of the psammomatoid form.
Langerhans cell histiocytosis is a histiocytic bone disease, not ossifying fibroma.
